methodology_summary.forest: Synthetic-control buffer-ring (5–30km donut) per West et al. 2020 PNAS approach. Hansen Global Forest Change v1.11 30m annual loss data. Project AOI vs. matched-neighbor buffer. Severity from ratio observed_avoided / claimed_avoided.
methodology_summary.methane: Carbon Mapper L4A point-source plume detections within facility AOI. Sector-filtered (IPCC 6A/1B/3). Implied capture rate from claim_capture / (claim + leakage).

what_this_tells_underwriters: For each project below, we have direct satellite-derived evidence of delivery vs. claim. RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE means the project area lost more forest than the matched-neighbor counterfactual — phantom credit pattern. SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY means observed avoided loss is <25% of claimed. These are not pattern-match predictions; they are reconciliations of primary remote-sensing data against project claims.
